name: Feedback Collection
description: A dataset consisting of 1K fine-grained score rubrics, 20K instructions, and 100K responses with language feedback generated by GPT-4, designed to train and evaluate language models for fine-grained evaluation of long-form text based on customized score rubrics.
reputation: A useful but specialized dataset for rubric-based long-form evaluation, with limited adoption outside work on feedback generation and LLM-as-judge style assessment.
notes: Dataset used to train Prometheus, an open-source LLM evaluator comparable to GPT-4 for customized evaluation criteria.
